name: Introduction to Electrical Engineering
source: 01_UG_EE_Curriculum_2026 (Tables 3, 6, 8; lab contact hours 6 in Table 3 vs 3 in Table 6)
description: Introduces the fundamental concepts of electrical engineering, including basic electrical quantities, circuit elements, electrical energy systems, and engineering applications. Provides an overview of major areas in electrical engineering and their practical relevance.

name: Circuit Theory
source: 01_UG_EE_Curriculum_2026 (Tables 3, 6, 8; lab contact hours 6 in Table 3 vs 3 in Table 6)
description: Covers analysis techniques for electrical circuits using network theorems and circuit laws. Topics include DC and AC circuit analysis, transient response, resonance, and two port networks, forming the foundation for advanced electrical engineering subjects.

name: Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
source: 01_UG_EE_Curriculum_2026 (Tables 3, 6, 8; lab contact hours 6 in Table 3 vs 3 in Table 6)
description: Introduces fundamental data structures and algorithmic techniques used in engineering and computational problem-solving. Covers arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, sorting, searching, and basic algorithm analysis.

name: Signals and Systems
source: 01_UG_EE_Curriculum_2026 (Tables 3, 6, 8; lab contact hours 6 in Table 3 vs 3 in Table 6)
description: Introduces representation and analysis of continuous-time and discrete-time signals and systems. Covers linear time invariant systems, convolution, Fourier and Laplace transforms, and system response, forming the foundation for signal processing and control applications.

name: Measurements and Instrumentation
source: 01_UG_EE_Curriculum_2026 (Tables 3, 6, 8; lab contact hours 6 in Table 3 vs 3 in Table 6)
description: Covers principles of electrical measurements and instrumentation techniques. Topics include sensors, transducers, measurement systems, signal conditioning, and performance characteristics of measuring instruments used in engineering applications.

name: Engineering Electromagnetics
source: 01_UG_EE_Curriculum_2026 (Tables 3, 6, 8; lab contact hours 6 in Table 3 vs 3 in Table 6)
description: Covers fundamental concepts of electromagnetic fields and waves, including electrostatics, magnetostatics, and Maxwell’s equations. Emphasizes field analysis, wave propagation, and their applications in electrical engineering systems.
